```{r}
mh <- function(log_target, rprop, dprop = NULL, x0, iter = 2000) {
	x <- matrix(NA, iter + 1, length(x0))
	x[1, ] <- x0
	accepted <- 0

	for (i in 1:iter) {
		cur <- x[i, ]
		cand <- rprop(cur)

		r <- log_target(cand) - log_target(cur)
		if (!is.null(dprop)) {
			r <- r + dprop(cur, cand) - dprop(cand, cur)
		}

		if (log(runif(1)) < r) {
			x[i + 1, ] <- cand
			accepted <- accepted + 1
		} else {
			x[i + 1, ] <- cur
		}
	}

	list(
	     chain = drop(x),
	     acceptance_rate = accepted / iter
	)
}
```

```{r}
rjmcmc <- function(log_target, rprop, x0, iter = 2000L) {
	if (length(iter) != 1L || !is.finite(iter) ||
	    iter < 1 || iter != floor(iter)) {
		stop("iter must be a positive integer.")
	}

	chain <- vector("list", iter + 1L)
	chain[[1L]] <- x0
	current_log_target <- log_target(x0)

	if (length(current_log_target) != 1L ||
	    !is.finite(current_log_target)) {
		stop("The initial state must have a finite log target density.")
	}

	accepted <- logical(iter)
	moves <- character(iter)

	for (i in seq_len(iter)) {
		cur <- chain[[i]]
		proposal <- rprop(cur)
		cand <- proposal$state
		moves[i] <- proposal$move

		candidate_log_target <- log_target(cand)

		if (length(candidate_log_target) != 1L ||
		    is.na(candidate_log_target) ||
		    candidate_log_target == Inf) {
			stop("The candidate log target must be finite or -Inf.")
		}

		r <- candidate_log_target - current_log_target +
			proposal$log_reverse - proposal$log_forward +
			proposal$log_jacobian

		if (length(r) != 1L || is.na(r)) {
			stop("Invalid acceptance ratio; check proposal probabilities.")
		}

		if (log(runif(1L)) < r) {
			chain[[i + 1L]] <- cand
			current_log_target <- candidate_log_target
			accepted[i] <- TRUE
		} else {
			chain[[i + 1L]] <- cur
		}
	}

	list(
	     chain = chain,
	     model = vapply(chain, function(s) s$k, integer(1L)),
	     accepted = accepted,
	     move = moves,
	     acceptance_rate = mean(accepted),
	     acceptance_by_move = tapply(accepted, moves, mean)
	)
}
```

```{r}
test_rjmcmc_prior <- function(iter = 1e5L, kmax = 5L, lambda = 2,
			      mu = 1, s = 2, jacobian = TRUE, seed = 1) {
	set.seed(seed)

	log_target <- function(state) {
		dpois(state$k, lambda, log = TRUE) +
			sum(dnorm(state$theta, 0, 1, log = TRUE))
	}

	move_probs <- function(k) {
		if (k == 0L) {
			c(birth = 1, death = 0, update = 0)
		} else if (k == kmax) {
			c(birth = 0, death = 0.5, update = 0.5)
		} else {
			c(birth = 1 / 3, death = 1 / 3, update = 1 / 3)
		}
	}

	log_jac <- if (jacobian) log(s) else 0

	rprop <- function(cur) {
		k <- cur$k
		pr <- move_probs(k)
		move <- sample(names(pr), 1L, prob = pr)

		if (move == "birth") {
			u <- rnorm(1)
			list(
			     state = list(k = k + 1L, theta = c(cur$theta, mu + s * u)),
			     move = move,
			     log_forward = log(pr[["birth"]]) + dnorm(u, log = TRUE),
			     log_reverse = log(move_probs(k + 1L)[["death"]]),
			     log_jacobian = log_jac
			)
		} else if (move == "death") {
			u <- (cur$theta[k] - mu) / s
			list(
			     state = list(k = k - 1L, theta = cur$theta[-k]),
			     move = move,
			     log_forward = log(pr[["death"]]),
			     log_reverse = log(move_probs(k - 1L)[["birth"]]) +
				     dnorm(u, log = TRUE),
			     log_jacobian = -log_jac
			)
		} else {
			j <- sample.int(k, 1L)
			theta <- cur$theta
			theta[j] <- theta[j] + rnorm(1, 0, 0.5)
			list(
			     state = list(k = k, theta = theta),
			     move = move,
			     log_forward = 0, log_reverse = 0, log_jacobian = 0
			)
		}
	}

	out <- rjmcmc(log_target, rprop, list(k = 0L, theta = numeric(0)), iter)

	expected <- dpois(0:kmax, lambda)
	expected <- expected / sum(expected)
	observed <- tabulate(out$model + 1L, nbins = kmax + 1L) / length(out$model)
	k_check <- data.frame(
			      k = 0:kmax, expected = round(expected, 4), observed = round(observed, 4)
	)

	th1 <- unlist(lapply(out$chain, function(st) if (st$k >= 1L) st$theta[1]))

	list(
	     k_check = k_check,
	     max_abs_diff = max(abs(observed - expected)),
	     theta1_mean_sd = c(mean = mean(th1), sd = sd(th1)),
	     acceptance_by_move = out$acceptance_by_move
	)
}
```

```{r}
test_rjmcmc_prior()
```

```{r}
coal_mining <- data(coalMining)
```

```{r}
years  <- coalMining$years
counts <- coalMining$accidents

year_min <- min(years)
year_max <- max(years)
all_tau  <- seq(year_min + 1L, year_max, 1L)
N_tau    <- length(all_tau)


a_rate  <- 2;  b_rate <- 1
kmax_cp <- 10L;  k_prior <- 3

seg_stats <- function(tau, k) {
	breaks <- c(year_min - 1L, sort(tau), year_max)
	lapply(seq_len(k + 1L), function(j) {
		       mask <- years > breaks[j] & years <= breaks[j + 1L]
		       list(n = sum(counts[mask]), T = sum(mask))
	})
}

log_target_coal <- function(state) {
	k      <- state$k
	tau    <- state$tau
	lambda <- state$lambda
	breaks <- c(year_min - 1L, sort(tau), year_max)
	ll <- 0
	for (j in seq_len(k + 1L)) {
		mask <- years > breaks[j] & years <= breaks[j + 1L]
		ll   <- ll + sum(dpois(counts[mask], lambda[j], log = TRUE))
	}
	dpois(k, k_prior, log = TRUE) -
		lchoose(N_tau, k) +
		sum(dgamma(lambda, a_rate, rate = b_rate, log = TRUE)) +
		ll
}

move_probs_coal <- function(k) {
	if (k == 0L)
		c(birth = 1, death = 0, move_cp = 0, update_lam = 0)
	else if (k >= kmax_cp)
		c(birth = 0, death = 1/3, move_cp = 1/3, update_lam = 1/3)
	else
		c(birth = 1/4, death = 1/4, move_cp = 1/4, update_lam = 1/4)
}

rprop_coal <- function(cur) {
	k      <- cur$k
	tau    <- cur$tau
	lambda <- cur$lambda
	pr     <- move_probs_coal(k)
	move   <- sample(names(pr), 1L, prob = pr)

	if (move == "birth") {
		avail    <- setdiff(all_tau, tau)
		tau_star <- sample(avail, 1L)
		lam_star <- rgamma(1L, a_rate, rate = b_rate)
		m        <- sum(tau < tau_star)
		new_tau  <- sort(c(tau, tau_star))
		new_lam  <- append(lambda, lam_star, after = m + 1L)
		pr_new   <- move_probs_coal(k + 1L)
		list(
		     state        = list(k = k + 1L, tau = new_tau, lambda = new_lam),
		     move         = move,
		     log_forward  = log(pr[["birth"]]) + log(1 / length(avail)) +
			     dgamma(lam_star, a_rate, rate = b_rate, log = TRUE),
		     log_reverse  = log(pr_new[["death"]]) + log(1 / (k + 1L)),
		     log_jacobian = 0
		)
	} else if (move == "death") {
		j       <- sample.int(k, 1L)
		lam_rem <- lambda[j + 1L]
		new_tau <- tau[-j]
		new_lam <- lambda[-(j + 1L)]
		pr_new  <- move_probs_coal(k - 1L)
		avail_after <- setdiff(all_tau, new_tau)
		list(
		     state        = list(k = k - 1L, tau = new_tau, lambda = new_lam),
		     move         = move,
		     log_forward  = log(pr[["death"]]) + log(1 / k),
		     log_reverse  = log(pr_new[["birth"]]) + log(1 / length(avail_after)) +
			     dgamma(lam_rem, a_rate, rate = b_rate, log = TRUE),
		     log_jacobian = 0
		)
	} else if (move == "move_cp") {
		j       <- sample.int(k, 1L)
		avail   <- setdiff(all_tau, tau)
		tau_new <- sample(avail, 1L)
		list(
		     state        = list(k = k, tau = sort(c(tau[-j], tau_new)), lambda = lambda),
		     move         = move,
		     log_forward  = 0, log_reverse = 0, log_jacobian = 0
		)
	} else { 
		j       <- sample.int(k + 1L, 1L)
		s       <- seg_stats(tau, k)[[j]]
		new_lam    <- lambda
		new_lam[j] <- rgamma(1L, a_rate + s$n, rate = b_rate + s$T)
		list(
		     state        = list(k = k, tau = tau, lambda = new_lam),
		     move         = move,
		     log_forward  = dgamma(new_lam[j], a_rate + s$n, rate = b_rate + s$T, log = TRUE),
		     log_reverse  = dgamma(lambda[j],  a_rate + s$n, rate = b_rate + s$T, log = TRUE),
		     log_jacobian = 0
		)
	}
}

set.seed(42)
coal_init <- list(k = 1L, tau = 1900L, lambda = c(3.0, 1.0))
coal_out  <- rjmcmc(log_target_coal, rprop_coal, coal_init, iter = 50000L)

cat("Acceptance rate:", coal_out$acceptance_rate, "\n")
cat("Acceptance by move:\n");  print(coal_out$acceptance_by_move)

k_post <- coal_out$model
cat("\nPosterior on number of changepoints:\n")
print(prop.table(table(k_post)))


k1_chains <- coal_out$chain[k_post == 1L]
if (length(k1_chains) > 0) {
	tau1 <- sapply(k1_chains, function(s) s$tau)
	cat("\nPosterior mean changepoint (k=1 states):", mean(tau1), "\n")
	png("../res_img/tau1_posterior.png", width = 800, height = 500)
	hist(tau1, breaks = 30, main = "Posterior of changepoint | k=1",
	     xlab = "Year", col = "steelblue", border = "white",
	     cex.main = 1.4, cex.lab = 1.2, cex.axis = 1.1)
	dev.off()
	hist(tau1, breaks = 30, main = "Posterior of changepoint | k=1",
	     xlab = "Year", col = "steelblue", border = "white",
	     cex.main = 1.4, cex.lab = 1.2, cex.axis = 1.1)
}
```

```{r}
burnin  <- 10000L
idx     <- seq(burnin + 1L, length(coal_out$chain))
chain_s <- coal_out$chain[idx]

fitted <- sapply(chain_s, function(st) {
			 k      <- st$k
			 tau    <- st$tau
			 lambda <- st$lambda
			 breaks <- c(year_min - 1L, sort(tau), year_max)
			 rate   <- numeric(length(years))
			 for (j in seq_len(k + 1L)) {
				 mask       <- years > breaks[j] & years <= breaks[j + 1L]
				 rate[mask] <- lambda[j]
			 }
			 rate
	})

post_mean <- rowMeans(fitted)
post_lo   <- apply(fitted, 1, quantile, 0.025)
post_hi   <- apply(fitted, 1, quantile, 0.975)

png("../res_img/fitted_rate.png", width = 800, height = 500)
plot(years, counts, type = "h", col = "grey70", lwd = 2,
     main = "Coal mining disasters with posterior fitted rate",
     xlab = "Year", ylab = "Accidents",
     cex.main = 1.4, cex.lab = 1.2, cex.axis = 1.1)
polygon(c(years, rev(years)), c(post_hi, rev(post_lo)),
	col = adjustcolor("steelblue", alpha.f = 0.3), border = NA)
lines(years, post_mean, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Observed", "Posterior mean rate", "95% CI"),
       col = c("grey70", "steelblue", adjustcolor("steelblue", 0.3)),
       lty = c(1, 1, NA), lwd = c(2, 2, NA),
       pch = c(NA, NA, 15), pt.cex = 1.5, bty = "n", cex = 1.1)
dev.off()
plot(years, counts, type = "h", col = "grey70", lwd = 2,
     main = "Coal mining disasters with posterior fitted rate",
     xlab = "Year", ylab = "Accidents",
     cex.main = 1.4, cex.lab = 1.2, cex.axis = 1.1)
polygon(c(years, rev(years)), c(post_hi, rev(post_lo)),
	col = adjustcolor("steelblue", alpha.f = 0.3), border = NA)
lines(years, post_mean, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Observed", "Posterior mean rate", "95% CI"),
       col = c("grey70", "steelblue", adjustcolor("steelblue", 0.3)),
       lty = c(1, 1, NA), lwd = c(2, 2, NA),
       pch = c(NA, NA, 15), pt.cex = 1.5, bty = "n", cex = 1.1)
```
